get.description: Search active source Markdown files with one standalone natural-language question. Omitted mode uses hybrid retrieval. Optional request-scoped reranking refines authorized candidates and safely falls back when unavailable. Every result remains a source-file candidate with read actions; read the Markdown before using its content as evidence.

query.query: How do I configure and verify the knowledge base deployment?

parameters.name: knowledgeBaseId
parameters.description: Knowledge-base identifier returned by knowledge-base APIs.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: One standalone natural-language question or search text. After Unicode and whitespace normalization it must contain 2 through 512 grapheme clusters, use at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes, and contain no unsafe control characters. Results are source files that must be read before their content is used as evidence.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Eligible evidence fields. `path` runs exact-path and grounded-title families, `metadata` runs the lexical metadata family, and `all` uses every family enabled by the selected mode.

parameters.name: fileKind
parameters.description: Readable-file type filter. Search returns active Markdown pages created from uploaded files. `all` removes the explicit type predicate but currently returns the same page set.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Search strategy. `file` searches file data and semantic similarity, `graph` follows file relationships and graph-derived semantic signals, and `hybrid` combines both. `scope` narrows the searched fields. Every result remains a readable source file.

parameters.name: graphDepth
parameters.description: Relationship context depth returned for graph and hybrid results. `0` returns the seed graph reference without relationships, `1` includes direct relationships, and `2` may include second-level relationships within `graphFanout`. Values above the deployment maximum return 422.

parameters.name: graphFanout
parameters.description: Maximum relationship records returned per graph search result across the requested depth. When omitted, the deployment setting is used; values above the deployment maximum return 422.

parameters.name: okfStatus
parameters.description: Return only files whose normalized OKF document status matches this value. Files with an invalid status are excluded.

parameters.name: okfTrustTier
parameters.description: Return only files whose normalized OKF verification tier matches this value. Files with invalid verification metadata are excluded.

parameters.name: okfFreshness
parameters.description: Return only files whose valid `stale_after` date is fresh or stale on the request date. Files without a valid stale date are excluded.

parameters.name: rerank
parameters.description: Optionally rerank the authorized fused source-file candidates with the active Admin-configured reranker. The default keeps deterministic fused ranking.

parameters.name: rerankTopK
parameters.description: Candidate count sent to the optional reranker. It is valid only with `rerank=true`, must be at least `limit`, and defaults to the greater of 30 and `limit`.

parameters.name: rerankScoreThreshold
parameters.description: Minimum normalized reranker score for non-exact candidates. It is valid only with `rerank=true` and defaults to 0.35.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Final source-file result count for this search request.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination token returned by the same search query, filters, readable knowledge-base version, and effective ranking settings.

200.description: Readable files ranked by relevance to the supplied query.
